description: This file defines the EmployeeClaimRequestAPI class, which provides API endpoints for managing employee claim requests in the OrangeHRM HR management system. It includes methods for creating claim requests, fetching lists of requests, retrieving specific requests, and managing claim request data with validation, authorization, and filtering support.

classes.name: EmployeeClaimRequestAPI
